title: Passage 1 - A voicemail from your manager
instructions: Listen to passage 1 twice, then choose the best answer.

options: to tell you the client has rejected your timeline
to express doubts about the proposed schedule
to ask you to hand the Henderson project over to Daniel
a: b
to express doubts about the proposed schedule
b) to express doubts about the proposed schedule

items.q: What does Laura really think about the timeline?
options: It is more cautious than she expected.
It is achievable only if Daniel joins the team.
It is too ambitious as it stands.
items.why: 'More optimistic than I'd expected' + 'I'm not saying it can't be done, but...' = polite doubt.
a: c
It is too ambitious as it stands.

options: letting Daniel negotiate the deadline with the client

committing to the client now and adjusting the plan later
